values.note: Regular season from the first weekend in May through the third weekend in October (dates here are 2027's). Sites 9-12 and two camper cabins also open for winter camping January 2 - March 31, at regular prices.

season.source: https://www.olmstedcounty.gov/residents/parks-recreation/recreation/camping ('Our regular camping season at Chester Woods Park runs the first weekend in May through the third weekend in October.'; 'Chester Woods campground also has select sites for winter camping from January 2 to March 31, 2027.'; 'Campsites 9, 10, 11, 12 and Camper Cabins Oak and Maple are available'; 'Pricing is the same as regular camping season'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Olmsted County's ResNexus site. Reservations up to six months before arrival; online booking for the regular season opens January 2. Season-long use prohibited: 10 consecutive days, then 24 hours out of the campground. Refunds only more than seven days out; the booking fee is not refunded.

values.note: Electric sites $35 a night; camper cabin $75; parking free. A booking fee is charged (amount not posted). Read 2026-11-11.
